mapper.insert: INSERT INTO thing_model (id, tenant_id, device_type_id, code, display_name, model_version, schema_document, status, published_at, created_at) VALUES (#{model.id}, #{model.tenantId}, #{model.deviceTypeId}, #{model.code}, #{model.displayName}, #{model.modelVersion}, CAST(#{model.schemaDocument} AS jsonb), #{model.status}, #{model.publishedAt}, #{model.createdAt})

INSERT INTO thing_model_parameter (tenant_id, thing_model_id, parameter_id, unit_id, required, sort_order, access_mode) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{thingModelId}, #{parameterId}, #{unitId}, #{required}, #{sortOrder}, #{accessMode})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, device_type_id, code, display_name, model_version, schema_document::text AS schema_document, status, published_at, created_at FROM thing_model WHERE id = #{thingModelId}
SELECT parameter_id, unit_id, required, sort_order, access_mode FROM thing_model_parameter WHERE thing_model_id = #{thingModelId} ORDER BY sort_order
SELECT count(*) FROM thing_model WHERE code = #{code} AND model_version = #{modelVersion}
SELECT count(*) FROM unit_catalog first_unit JOIN unit_catalog second_unit ON second_unit.dimension = first_unit.dimension WHERE first_unit.id = #{firstUnitId} AND second_unit.id = #{secondUnitId}
